thread:
kevin: FYI staging canary for MIG-1422 produced a recurrent 2-minute exclusive row lock during the backfill step. I'm going to suggest we pause the midnight window until we pin a mitigation.
tara: ack. can you paste the lockwatch snippet?
kevin: pasted: https://staging-logs/mig-1422/lockwatch. Pattern is ALTER TABLE -> immediate UPDATE batches piling up.
leo: quick mitigation: deploy MIG-1422-v0.1-hotfix which doesn't change schema but sets BACKFILL_BATCH=150 and BACKFILL_SLEEP_MS=150.
kevin: sounds good. rollout plan: 1) pause backfill workers on canary hosts 2) deploy pinned hotfix to 2 canary shards 3) monitor lock_count, any lock >180s => HOLD+rollback 4) if stable 30m -> phased rollout, unpin at 06:00 UTC
deploybot: MIG-1422 scheduled for 00:00-06:00 UTC. Current status: HOLD until kevins ack and pinned_version is set. Tourniquet available: pause_on_lock_threshold=3/5m.
ops-bot: added alert policy: if pause_on_lock_threshold fires, page eng-oncall and post incident stub in #incidents.
ci-bot: CI artifacts: https://ci/artifacts/1422/v0.1-hotfix. run_id=run-1422-20260327-01
tara: I'll update infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json with pinned_version: "MIG-1422-v0.1-hotfix" and short release note: "reduced batch and inter-batch sleep to avoid lock contention"
leo: adding a temporary safety: deploybot rule tourniquet:MIG-1422 auto-scale-down-workers -> set BACKFILL_CONCURRENCY=1 if lock_count>2 in 3m.
kevin: applying pause and deploying v0.1-hotfix to canary now.
tara: canary results after 22m: no locks >45s, p99 latency stable. replication lag unchanged.
leo: good. keep pinned until 06:00 and add follow-up to postmortem: expand backfill-sim to include concurrent ALTER+UPDATE.
kevin: will attach run_id and logs to release notes and close thread unless regressions appear.
deploybot: MIG-1422 rollout progressed: canary->10%->50% without auto-pause. :white_check_mark:
